children.value: > Fact From Story That ruling showed Petitti is not afraid to take on one of the Big Two within the conference.
> > Fact From Story Petitti upheld sportsmanship within the conference, but it could lead to a long-term rift with Michigan.

> > > Fact From Story Tony Petitti, in letter to Michigan, says that the school initially refused to consent to the Big Ten obtaining the spreadsheet and other documents from the NCAA related to its investigation.
> > > Commonsense Knowledge Refusing to consent to an investigation suggests a fear of what the investigation might reveal.
> > Commonsense Knowledge Upholding sportsmanship is important for a conference commissioner.
> Fact From Story Tony Petitti certainly did not hit Michigan with a "slap on the wrist."
> > Fact From Story The Big Ten announced Michigan coach Jim Harbaugh will be prohibited from coaching on the sideline for the remainder of the regular season.

> > > > > > Fact From Story The Friday ruling is the next chapter in an NCAA investigation into Michigan for in-person scouting and sign stealing in a scandal that led to the resignation of staffer Connor Stallions on Nov. 3. | Fact From Story
> > > > > > Fact From Story Harbaugh will be allowed to coach during the week but will not be able to be on the sideline. | Fact From Story
> > > > > > Commonsense Knowledge Investigations and scandal reflect badly on a team and its coach. | Commonsense Knowledge
> > Commonsense Knowledge Prohibiting a coach from coaching is a significant punishment in college football.
> Commonsense Knowledge A "slap on the wrist" is a light punishment.
